# SubSurface.io

> SubSurface.io is multipurpose software that automatically estimates geotechnical, structural, and earthquake engineering parameters.

The Features page lists every public capability. This file is a map for agents.

## Docs

- [Home](https://docs.subsurfaceio.app/): Links to the web app and API
- [Features](https://docs.subsurfaceio.app/features/): Public capabilities
- [Examples](https://docs.subsurfaceio.app/examples/api/): Runnable API scripts
- [Catalog](https://docs.subsurfaceio.app/catalog/): Parameters, function sequences, references, datasets, graphics
- [Function sequences](https://docs.subsurfaceio.app/catalog/function_sequences/): Named calculation recipes
- [Parameters](https://docs.subsurfaceio.app/catalog/parameters/): Named calculation parameters
- [References](https://docs.subsurfaceio.app/catalog/references/): Bibliographic sources
- [Package reference](https://docs.subsurfaceio.app/reference/subsurfaceio/): Python API
- [Site investigation](https://docs.subsurfaceio.app/reference/subsurfaceio/site_investigation/): CPT, DMT, SPT, lab, plots, reports, and export

## Optional

- [Web app](https://subsurfaceio.app/)
- [Interactive API documentation](https://www.subsurfaceio.app/docs)
- [Source](https://github.com/subsurfaceiodev/subsurfaceio)
